name: qr-track-lite
description: Self-hosted, cookie-free QR code generator and scan tracker for printed postcards and flyers, on Cloudflare Workers.

ADMIN_SECRET.description: Bearer token for creating and managing links, at least 16 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

LINKS.description: Stores link records (slug to destination). Read on every scan.

SCANS.description: One Durable Object per link: exact scan counts and scan history.
